resources.string: ztMetro-izes the stock Settings app: flat black page header (SETTINGS caps label + 48sp lowercase title + subtitle), icon-free flat preference rows, black square dialogs with accent buttons, ВКЛ/ВЫКЛ switch rows, square segmented/radio groups, and the 40dp back/ZRN/search bottom bar. Module scope: com.android.settings + com.android.settings.intelligence (search results).
